title: Prewire and structured wiring

roles.label: 42" structured media enclosure
roles.capability: Central enclosure where every cable home-runs

roles.label: C2G 12-port keystone patch panel
roles.capability: Every run terminates on a keystone jack in a 12-port blank keystone patch panel, one panel per 12 drops, in place of a structured media enclosure (Henry, 2026-10-27). Livewire has quoted no 8- or 12-port panel since 2024 (six patch panels, on 1-2 quotes each, all 24 or 48 ports); the C2G 03857 is the catalog's only small keystone panel

roles.label: Cat6 keystone jack

quantity.verify: count of data outlets, TV locations, access points and cameras

roles.capability: Cat6 home run to the enclosure, terminated on a keystone jack; a retrofit drop takes a jack at each end and 2 hours (Henry, 2026-10-27: Cat6 Retro carries 2 jacks on 75 of 114 drops and a median 2 hours per drop on 86 packages across 64 accepted or presented Livewire quotes; Cat6 Run 1 hour on 248 packages across 50, D-Tools 2024-2026)

retrofit_units.verify: 2 keystone jacks per retrofit drop: one at the wall plate, one at the patch panel or enclosure

roles.label: Wirepath 1-port keystone wall plate

quantity.verify: one plate per outlet location, sized to its ports

roles.capability: Keystone wall plates the request names, one per drop, or one per 2 or 4 drops when it names 2- or 4-port plates (Henry, 2026-10-27): Wirepath PLATE-1-WH is on 300 accepted or presented Livewire quotes, PLATE-2-WH on 58 and PLATE-4-WH on 38 (D-Tools, 2024-2026)

roles.label: Cat6 cable (per foot)

quantity.verify: about 75 ft of Cat6 per data outlet

roles.capability: Cat6 550 MHz cable for the data runs

roles.label: Coax outlet
roles.capability: RG6 home run for cable, satellite or antenna

roles.label: Speaker prewire

quantity.verify: count of speaker locations (one per pair of terminals)

roles.capability: Speaker wire roughed in for future speakers

labor.basis: Livewire packages since 2025: Cat6 Run 1 hour per drop (30 ft), Cat6 Retro 2 hours (75 ft), as one hour on each of a retrofit drop's two jacks (median 2 hours on 86 Cat6 Retro packages, 64 accepted or presented quotes, D-Tools 2024-2026); enclosure set and home-run termination about 2 hours; coax and speaker drops about 0.75 hours each in new construction

assumptions: New construction or open walls: cables are run before drywall.
One rough-in visit and one trim-out visit.
Quantities marked as minimums are confirmed against the floor plan.
exclusions: Equipment for the outlets (TVs, access points, speakers) unless listed.
Electrical work and permits unless listed.
